Checks: 'contains' (numbers match numerically, text items are regexes), 'absent' (regexes that must not match), 'not_available' (the answer must say the data is missing). Every answer is also checked for invented numbers and for the expected language. 'lang' en cases decide; hu cases are reported for information.

cases.question: What does a GGT test measure?

context.reference_context:
Gamma-glutamyl Transferase (GGT) Test (https://medlineplus.gov/lab-tests/gamma-glutamyl-transferase-ggt-test/):
A GGT test measures the amount of GGT in your blood. GGT is an enzyme found mostly in the liver. High levels may be a sign of liver damage or a problem with the bile ducts. Drinking alcohol can also raise GGT levels.
